description: Large-scale performance and capability benchmark of the rendering engine. It sweeps spacetime metrics, celestial body counts, secondary black hole counts, performance presets and space skipping on the CPU and GPU compute paths, and reports frame times, throughput, ray statistics, scaling exponents and capability envelopes.

checks.label: at least one metric scenario is selected
the scenario matrix is not empty
all 16 executed cases satisfy the sanity invariants
CPU and GPU renderings of the reference scene do not diverge grossly
